author: agent-intraday-hourly
name: Index gap-down fill (buy 3x bull at open, sell at prior close or close), long history

author: agent-overnight
name: 3x fund overnight tracking: dividend add-back and financing carry (UPRO/TQQQ/TNA/SOXL/FAS vs 3x ETF)
hypothesis: A 3x fund's overnight return = 3 x the ETF's overnight return; the leverage financing is charged somewhere
data: Yahoo 1d 2008/2010-2026 for the funds and ETFs, ^IRX
method: fund r_on - 3 x ETF r_on (both dividend-corrected), regressed on per-night T-bill rate; split by weekday
notes: Overnight holder bears ~2.4 x T-bill per year on the fund dollars (charged per trading night, weekend accrual on Thursday->Friday nights); the fund does NOT drop on the ETF's ex-dividend night, so backtests from raw ETF opens understate by 3 x the dividend on those nights. Cost model now in core.py (CARRY_A=2.4). Measurement, not a strategy variant.

author: agent-overnight

author: agent-overnight
name: (a) Validation of the live spec: stationary bootstrap CIs, CSCV PBO, White RC / Hansen SPA, deflated Sharpe
hypothesis: The live spec's edge is real and its parameter choice is not overfit
data: Yahoo 1d full history (SPY 1993-, QQQ 1999-, IWM 2000-, SMH/XLF 1999/2000-, 3x funds 2008/2010-), ^IRX, ^VIX, ^VIX3M, HYG, IEF; dividends
method: Politis-Romano bootstrap (b=5/20/60, 4000 draws); CSCV S=16 (12,870 splits) on a 96-variant spec grid (SMA 100-250 x sigma 10-60 x target 1-2% x cap 2/3); SPA vs spec over all program variants; DSR with 210 trials
notes: Spec is real (CI excludes 0, DSR 0.98, family beats cash p<0.001, PBO 0.12) but no variant beats it after the family-wide SPA (p 0.27). Spec ranks 38/96 in its own grid; grid averages favour cap 2 over 3 and longer SMA (250 > 200), the latter not tested out of sample.

author: agent-overnight
name: (b) Regime signals vs 200-day filter: TSMOM 21/63/126/252, Kalman LLT slope, 2-state HMM, VIX/VIX3M, VIX vs MA, HYG/IEF
hypothesis: A better regime filter raises out-of-sample Sharpe
data: Yahoo 1d full history (SPY 1993-, QQQ 1999-, IWM 2000-, SMH/XLF 1999/2000-, 3x funds 2008/2010-), ^IRX, ^VIX, ^VIX3M, HYG, IEF; dividends
method: replace or AND the 200d filter; HMM (Baum-Welch, filtered, Jan-1 refits) and Kalman MLE walk-forward; OOS 2008-2026; meta-rule picks best-so-far each Jan 1
notes: TSMOM majority vote: SR 0.80 vs 0.73 OOS (p 0.15), both halves >=, but WORSE pre-sample 2003-07 (0.77 vs 0.98) -> promising only. HMM, VIX term structure, VIX<MA, credit and Kalman all below the 200-day filter. Choosing among them each year (meta) gave SR 0.62.

author: agent-overnight
name: (c) Calendar/event nights: weekday, weekend, holiday, pre-holiday, turn of month, opex, jobs, CPI, FOMC
hypothesis: Overnight returns differ on calendar/event nights; skipping or sizing up helps
data: Yahoo 1d full history (SPY 1993-, QQQ 1999-, IWM 2000-, SMH/XLF 1999/2000-, 3x funds 2008/2010-), ^IRX, ^VIX, ^VIX3M, HYG, IEF; dividends; event dates approximate (BLS jobs rule; FOMC 2000-26 and CPI 2018-25 from memory; official sites unreachable)
method: Welch t flagged vs other trend-on nights; skip / x1.5 rules, direction chosen on 2001-07, judged 2008-26
notes: No rule adopted (best pre-chosen: skip post-opex nights dSR +0.05 p 0.19). FOMC-morning nights earn ~+15-19bp vs ~+5bp (pre-FOMC drift, both halves positive) and jobs/CPI nights are also above average: do NOT skip event nights. Sizing them up adds ~nothing because L is usually near its cap.

author: agent-overnight
name: (d) Sizing: EWMA/GARCH(1,1)/VIX vol forecasts, inverse variance, Bayesian fractional Kelly, per-leg caps, stress guard
hypothesis: Better vol forecasts or Kelly sizing raise Sharpe within the $100 worst-night limit
data: Yahoo 1d full history (SPY 1993-, QQQ 1999-, IWM 2000-, SMH/XLF 1999/2000-, 3x funds 2008/2010-), ^IRX, ^VIX, ^VIX3M, HYG, IEF; dividends
method: walk-forward GARCH MLE and VIX scaling (Jan-1 refits); QLIKE + Diebold-Mariano; Kelly mu = expanding posterior N(0, tau^2); caps 1.5-2.5; point-in-time stress guard
notes: ADOPT per-leg cap 2.0 + stress guard as a RISK-LIMIT fix: OOS SR 0.78 vs 0.73 (p 0.07; both halves higher; equal pre-sample), worst night -7.8% vs -10.8%, maxDD -24% vs -29%, CAGR 10.4% vs 12.3%. Not a significant alpha gain (sizing SPA p 0.45). GARCH/EWMA/VIX forecasts are better forecasts (DM t -2.5 to -5.3) but give no Sharpe gain; half-Kelly breaches the $100 limit (-12.3%); inverse variance worse.

author: agent-overnight
name: (e) Asset set: add SOXL (3x SMH) and/or FAS (3x XLF) legs, cap 3 and cap 2
hypothesis: More legs diversify the overnight premium and raise Sharpe
data: Yahoo 1d full history (SPY 1993-, QQQ 1999-, IWM 2000-, SMH/XLF 1999/2000-, 3x funds 2008/2010-), ^IRX, ^VIX, ^VIX3M, HYG, IEF; dividends
method: equal sleeve weights; same rules per leg; OOS 2008-26; real-fund re-run 2010-26; whole shares at today's prices
notes: Adding SMH/SOXL: OOS SR 0.90 vs 0.73 (cap 2), real funds 2010-26 0.96 vs 0.80, within-question SPA p 0.03; but no gain 2003-2009 and the family-wide SPA is p 0.27; gains come from 2010-26 (semis' boom). XLF alone adds nothing. 5 legs fail whole shares at $1,000 (FAS $161 > per-leg target). Shadow-track SOXL as a 4th leg.

author: main
name: Live spec revision: cap 2.0 per leg + historical-gap stress guard (from agent-overnight validation)
hypothesis: The cap-3 spec can breach the $100 per-trade limit on calm-market shocks (Brexit 2016: -10.8% of the sleeve)
data: agent-overnight: 2001-2026 daily + real 3x funds 2010-2026; realistic costs incl. financing carry and dividends
method: adopt cap 2.0 and stress = 3 x (0.040 D_SPY + 0.070 D_QQQ + 0.053 D_IWM) <= $100, combined with 5 sigma; nearest-share rounding
notes: Risk-limit fix, not a return claim (sizing SPA p 0.45). With half capital per night (cash account) expect about half the CAGR. Financing carry: ~2.7 bp/night per fund dollar at 4.1% T-bill, ~8 bp on Thursday nights; Thursday nights may be net-negative for 3x overnight holds: queued as a pre-registered test.

author: main
name: PILOT pre-registration: cash-day gap-down reversal, 9:45 entry, capped live pilot
hypothesis: Real fills keep enough of the +40-50 bp/day (9:45-entry estimate) edge to stay positive
data: Live, Robinhood, from Nov 19 2026
method: Rules: trade day t only if SPY closed below its 200-day SMA on t-1. Universe trader/data/superset.json, prior close >= $5, 14-day avg volume >= 1M. Rank by gap = first 1-minute price / prior close - 1 (<= -2%), most negative first; skip the account's own holdings and names priced above $95; take 5. Buy floor($95/ask) shares each with marketable limits at about 9:45; OCO per position (stop 8% below fill, take-profit +20%), good till cancelled; cancel and sell at market at ~15:55. Size cap: $475 total, never cash needed by tonight's overnight legs.
notes: Stop the pilot if: realized round-trip cost vs the 9:45 prints > 40 bp after 10 pilot days, or cumulative pilot loss > $100, or any owner limit would be breached. Evaluate at 20 pilot days and at the Nov 27 two-week review. Paper log for every cash day continues.

author: main
name: Inverse 3x fund in bear regime (below 200d), open->close and close->close
hypothesis: When SPY/QQQ/IWM are below their 200-day, holding an inverse 3x fund earns a positive return (user asked about shorting the Nov 2026 decline).
data: Daily OHLC SPY 1993-2026, QQQ 1999-, IWM 2000-; proxy -3x index return, no fees
method: Conditional means with t-stats and split halves; 5 conditions x 2 windows x 3 indexes
notes: Every tradeable variant is negative: after down days below the 200-day, the index tends to rise from the open (mean reversion), so inverse funds lose. close->close rows with a gap-down condition are look-ahead (the gap is inside the return) and are void. The mirror image (long at the open after down days below 200d) is +25 to +39bp/day x3, t 1.8-2.4, consistent with the gap-down reversal pilot; not separately adopted.
